checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the image is a close-up crop, rendering several checkpoints (console, pedalboard, stop knobs, full silhouette) untestable. I agree with marking these as 'N/A' rather than 'Missing', as they are simply out of frame. For the testable checkpoints, the Router was accurate: pipes are vertical and metallic, wood case is present. However, regarding the 'Ornate carved wood case' checkpoint, the Router marked it 'Checked'. While there is wood framing, it is relatively simple structural joinery rather than 'ornate carving'. I will maintain 'Checked' but note that the ornamentation is minimal; the structural integrity is the primary pass criteria here.
artifact_review: The Router reported no artifacts. The Perceptual Quality Auditor detected 'slight compression', which aligns with the visible pixelation in the wood grain and pipe reflections. The Topology Auditor gave a high confidence score (0.93), suggesting good boundary definition between pipes and wood, ruling out severe melting. However, visual inspection reveals subtle AI artifacts: the reflections on the central pipes are somewhat inconsistent (some show horizontal banding while others are smooth), and the wood texture has a slightly waxy/smudged quality typical of generative models. These are minor issues. The severity of 'slight compression' is appropriate, but I would add 'texture smearing' to the defect list.
alignment_reasoning: All testable checkpoints passed. The expert classifier confirmed 'pipe organ' with high confidence (logit 7.73). The image is a valid partial view of the target class. Score is near perfect because the visible elements are fully conformant, despite the crop limiting full verification.
